receipt.equivalence_review: Correct closed-world refusal. Full inventories and related physical contracts support a catalog gap rather than a keyword-only inference. I checked the pinned ADC ports and 8 SPS contract, reference feed network, INA219 onboard shunt and OPA197 unity-feedback topology against the submitted reasoning. Available power, mounting and UART support does not supply the missing 100 uA excitation and independent force/sense conversion function. All original quantitative requirements are retained; no substitute sensor or threshold waiver was accepted.

refusal.reason: The queried pinned catalog has no eligible verified implementation of 100 uA PT100 excitation with independent force/sense leads and calibrated 0–100 degC conversion meeting 0.5 degC absolute error at >=10 readings/s over 3.3 V UART. Related contracts were inspected: g3-adc measures voltage, fixes 8 samples/s and +/-4.096 V full scale, exports analog inputs but no excitation or temperature-conversion function; INA219 blocks sense an onboard shunt rather than exciting an external four-wire RTD; the thermistor and local I2C temperature blocks are different sensing mechanisms; the photodiode amplifier, DAC voltage output, unity buffer and shunt voltage-reference blocks do not supply the missing reviewed RTD function. Raw catalog op-amp/ADC parts do not constitute an eligible implemented block. USB sink and mounting support do not remedy this missing required function.
